text: The Colony Tau Canteen (Japanese: , Koronī Tau: Yagai Shokudō) is a Rest Spot in . It is located in Colony Tau in High Maktha Wildwood. The Maktha Ever-Greens can be purchased here.
The Colony Tau, Crop Fields (Japanese: , Koronī Tau: Minori no Hatake) is a Location in . It is located in Colony Tau in High Maktha Wildwood.
The Colony Tau, Ferronis Head (Japanese: , Koronī Tau: Tetsukyoshin Tōbu) is a Location in . It is located on top of Colony Tau's Ferronis in High Maktha Wildwood.

The Colony 11: East Gate (Japanese: , Koronī 11: Higashi Sumon) is a Landmark in . It is located in Colony 11 in the Syra Hovering Reefs. After both The Castle Guard and Festival of War are completed, the gate will open.
The Colony 11: West Gate (Japanese: , Koronī 11: Nishi Sumon) is a Landmark in . It is located in Colony 11 on the Syra Hovering Reefs.

The Colony 11 Canteen (Japanese: , Koronī 11: Yagai Shokudō) is a Rest Spot in . It is located in Colony 11 on the Syra Hovering Reefs, becoming available after The Wrath of Ashera is completed. The Mild Game Stew can be purchased here.
The Colony 11, Training Pit (Japanese: , Koronī 11: Renpeigō) is a Location in . It is located in Colony 11 on the Syra Hovering Reefs.

The Colony 9 Canteen (Japanese: , Koronī 9 Yagai Shokudō) is a Rest Spot in . It is located in Colony 9 in Yzana Plains. The Yapolta Veggie-Beans can be purchased here, as well as the Baked Spongy Spud after the quest Reasons to Evolve.
The Colony 4 Checkpoint (Japanese: , Koronī 4: Shueimon) is a Landmark in . It is located in Colony 4 in the Eagus Wilderness.
The Colony 4 Ferronis Hatch (Japanese: , Koronī 4: Tetsukyoshin Hatchi) is a Landmark in . It is located inside Colony 4's Ferronis in the Eagus Wilderness.
The Colony Iota Base Entrance (Japanese: , Koronī Iota: Kyoten Iriguchi) is a Landmark in . It is located in Colony Iota on Elaice Highway.
The Colony Iota South Gate (Japanese: , Koronī Iota: Nanmon) is a Landmark in . It is located in Elaice Highway, and is southern entrance into Colony Iota.

The Colony Iota Canteen (Japanese: , Koronī Iota: Yagai Shokudō) is a Rest Spot in . It is located in Colony Iota on Elaice Highway, becoming available after Her Reasons is completed. The Riverbird Crispygrill can be purchased here.
Conqueror's Peak (Japanese: , Seihasha no Gaijō) is a Landmark in , located on Rae-Bel Tableland.
The Colony Mu Main Gate (Japanese: , Koronī Myū: Seimon) is a Landmark in . It is located in Erythia Sea. It serves as the entrance into Colony Mu.
Conchrock Beach (Japanese: , Makigaigan no Sunahama) is a Landmark in . It is located on Migrow's Rosary in Erythia Sea.
The Colony Mu Barracks (Japanese: , Koronī Myū Heisha) is a Rest Spot in . It is located in Colony Mu in Erythia Sea.

The Colony Mu Canteen (Japanese: , Koronī Myū Yagai Shokudō) is a Rest Spot in . It is located in Colony Mu in Erythia Sea. The Sunny-Style Fish Pie can be purchased here, as well as the Pon-Fried Croquettes if Colony Mu is chosen during Crusader For Spuds.

The Colony Mu Hidden Coast (Japanese: , Koronī Myū: Urakaigan) is a Location in . It is located in the northern part of Colony Mu in Erythia Sea, serving as the rear entrance into the colony. There is a dock at the shore. After completing Transparent Dreams, the gate opens.
The Colony Mu Viewing Deck (Japanese: , Koronī Myū: Miwatari Hiroba) is a Location in . It is located in Colony Mu in Erythia Sea.
The Communal Cell Block (Japanese: , Zakkyobō Kukaku) is a Location in . It is located in Li Garte Prison Camp.
The Colony Omega Camp (Japanese: , Koronī Omega no Kyūsokuchi) is a Rest Spot in . It is located near Colony Omega on Captocorn Peak.
Colony Theta is an Agnian Colony in . It is not encountered in gameplay and so its location is unknown. It is unknown if the Colony still exists by the time the main story events occur.

Conqueror Deepwan (Japanese: , Banhaō Dīpuwan) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Igna family, and can be found at level 102 in the Demihuman Gutter in Erythia Sea. It forms the duo "The King-Kings" with King Krawkin. The King's Bash Art can be earned for the Soulhacker class upon defeating it.
Colony 29 is a Kevesi Colony in . A group of its soldiers attack the Jumbo Tirkin during the Ascension Quest, Knowing Your Family.
The Colony 4 Council Room (Japanese: , Koronī 4: Sakusen Kaigijitsu) is a Location in . It is located inside Colony 4's Ferronis in the Eagus Wilderness.
The Colony 5 Ferronis (Japanese: , Koronī 5: Tetsukyoshin) is a Location in . It is located on the Urayan Trail. This Ferronis is no longer active due to Colony 5's destruction.
Colony 9's Backup is a Standard Quest in . This quest is received during Melia's Ascension Quest, From Atop Her Throne.
The Colony Mu, Respite Ranch (Japanese: , Koronī Myū: Ikoi no Bokujō) is a Landmark in , located in Colony Mu in Erythia Sea. It is unlocked after The Future I Want to Spin is completed.
Condimenuts are Collectible items in . They can be found in the Pentelas Region. They can also be purchased from the Colony Lambda Caravan, or produced from the Cascade Ferronis Hulk Fabricator.

|-|XC3 = |-|FR = Comet Carrots are Vegetable Collectibles in and . They can be found in the Fornis Region in . They can also be purchased from the Colony 4 Caravan, or produced from the Desert Ferronis Hulk Fabricator. They can be found in the Vermilion Woods in . Two are needed for the Vermilion Woods Collectopaedia. In , they can also be purchased from the Col. 9 Supply Office (New).
Compressed Ansel Meats are Collectible items in . They can be obtained from the Ansel species of enemies. The common variant can also be purchased from Sunny & Cheerio's Caravan.
The Colony 4 Central Hangar (Japanese: , Koronī 4: Chūsū Kikanku) is a Location in . It is located inside Colony 4's Ferronis in the Eagus Wilderness.
The Colony 4 Central Yard (Japanese: , Koronī 4: Chūō Hiroba ) is a Location in . It is located in Colony 4 in the Eagus Wilderness.
The Colony 4 Observation Deck (Japanese: , Koronī 4: Tenbō Dekki ) is a Location in . It is located in Colony 4 in the Eagus Wilderness. It can be accessed from the Colony 4 Command.
The Colony 4 Medical Quarter (Japanese: , Koronī 4: Iryōkukaku) is a Location in . It is located in Colony 4 in the Eagus Wilderness.
The Colony 4 Commissary is a shop in . It is run by a Colony 4 Soldier and can be found in Colony 4 in Eagus Wilderness.
The Colony Iota Commissary is a shop in . It is run by a Colony Iota Soldier and can be found in Colony Iota in Elaice Highway.
The Colony 30 Commissary is a shop in . It is run by a Colony 30 Soldier and can be found in Colony 30 in Ribbi Flats.
The Colony 9 Command is a Location in . It is located inside the Colony 9 Ferronis in Yzana Plains.
The Colony Iota North Gate is a Location in . It is located in Elaice Highway, serving as the northern entrance of Colony Iota. After completing Her Reasons, the gate opens.
Colony 9 Caravan is a shop in . The shop becomes available upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Colony 9. It sells Aetia Region Collectibles.
Colony Gamma Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon in Colony Gamma on Melnath's Shoulder upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Colony Gamma. It sells Aetia Region Collectibles.
Colony 4 Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon in Colony 4 in Eagus Wilderness upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Colony 4. It sells Fornis Region Collectibles.
Colony 30 Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon in Colony 30 in Ribbi Flats upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Colony 30. It sells Fornis Region Collectibles.
Colony Iota Caravan is a shop in . The shop becomes available upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Colony Iota. It sells Fornis Region Collectibles.
Colony Lambda Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon in Colony Lambda at Great Cotte Falls upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Colony Lambda. It sells Pentelas Region Collectibles.
The Colony Tau Commissary is a shop in . It is run by a Colony Tau Soldier and can be found in Colony Tau in High Maktha Wildwood.
Colony Tau Caravan is a shop in . It is run by a Traderpon near the Colony Tau Ferronis in High Maktha Wildwood upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Colony Tau. It sells Pentelas Region Collectibles.
The Colony 11 Commissary is a shop in . It is run by a Colony 11 Soldier and can be found in Colony 11 on the Syra Hovering Reefs.
Colony 11 Caravan is a shop in . It is run by the Colony 11 Traderpon in Colony 11 on the Syra Hovering Reefs upon reaching Affinity Level 2 with Colony 11. It sells Keves Castle Region Collectibles.
The Colony Mu Commissary is a shop in . It is run by a Colony Mu Soldier and is located in Colony Mu in Erythia Sea.
Colony Mu Caravan is a shop in . It is located in Colony Mu upon achieving Affinity Level 2 with the Colony.
The Consolation Prize is a Key Item in . It is obtained if the party decides to hand over the resources inside the Supply Drop during Forgotten Supplies.
Colony Psi is an Agnian Colony in . They were responsible for the death of Jeremy's friend Mercutio, supposedly having fought Colony 4 in the past.
The Contract Bracelets are a DLC Key Item in . It can be during the Quest For the Sake of Keepsakes. They are made by Masha using Red Schorl and Argencium for Jake and Tessa.
The Colony 9 Camp (Japanese: , Koronī 9 no Kyūsokuchi ) is a Rest Spot in , located in Colony 9 in Yesterdale.
Colony 20 is a Kevesi Colony in . At some point, Colony 20 fought Colony Mu before the party ventures to Mu. A soldier in Colony Iota said she believed Colony Mu would come out on top.
Colony 23 is a Kevesi Colony in . A patrol of the colony's soldiers attack Gray during the Hero Quest A Gray Matter.

The Command Center (Japanese: , Shireijo) is a Landmark in , located in Colony 9 of Yesterdale. It is the command center of the Liberators. The Orbital Skyreader is displayed here after completing If Walls Could Speak. Just outside the Command Center is Gem Man's Furnace, which can be used to craft Gems after completing The Derelict Ether Furnace.
The Colony 9, Main Entrance (Japanese: , Koronī 9 Shōmenguchi) is a Landmark in , located within Colony 9 in Yesterdale. It is the entrance into Colony 9, appearing the same as it did in .

The Colony Eta Ferronis (Japanese: ) is a Boss in . It is the Ferronis of Colony Eta, and is fought at level 19 at the Diablada Cliffs on the Aurora Shelf. It is piloted by Consul W. Shulk officially joins the party during this fight.

The Colony 22, 7th Platoon Camp (Japanese: , Koronī 22 Daishichi Butai Yaeichi) is a location in , located beind the Colony 5 Wreckage in Vermilion Woods. It is a camp occupied by soldiers of Colony 22 that appears after starting Chapter 4.
Colony Pazza Recipe is a Key Item in . It allows the party to cook Kickin' Colony Acqua Pazza at Rest Spots. It is obtained upon completing Cooking with Rex, Part 1.

The Colony 9 Supply Office is a shop in . It is run by a Liberator Soldier and can be found at Colony 9's Ether Light in Yesterdale. After completing Abandoned Supplies, more items are added to the shop's inventory.
Colony 22 is a Kevesi Colony in . Its soldiers set up a platoon camp behind the wreckage of Colony 5's Ferronis in Vermilion Woods. The location of the colony itself is unknown.
Colony Eta is an Agnian Colony in . Its Ferronis is used by Consul W to attack the party, with him fusing it with himself and a Kevesi Ferronis. The location of the colony itself is unknown.
* Keves Blocker Elite * Keves Rescuer * Keves Sniper * Equites * Velites during Knowing Your Family.
Colony 16 is a Kevesi Colony in . It is mentioned by a soldier in the Colony 9 Assembly Square after Colony 9 becomes Tin rank.

Contrition is a track from , composed by ACE. It is track four of disc three from the Xenoblade 2 Original Soundtrack, and track four of disc eight from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments: * Pyra and Azurda's late-night conversation on the Lower Level of Gormott. * Pyra's conversation with Cole in Fonsa Myma. * Mythra scolding Rex about being reawakened during Vandham's funeral. * The reveal of the plans of Rhys's group to avenge their village using Roc's Core Crystal. * Tora's story about how his family was attacked during Lila's construction and how Tora ended up without his dadapon and grampypon. * Mythra and Nia's discussion about

Confronting Our Past is a track from , composed by Yasunori Mitsuda. It is track seven of disc four from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track seven of disc fifteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments: * When Noah, Eunie, and Lanz fight Agnus Soldiers in Alfeto Valley during Chapter 1. * When Taion's Ouroboros manifests for the first time. * As the party struggles to fight Moebius D & J while the Keves Castle Annihilator begins preparing to fire. * When the Lost Numbers crash into the Throne Room of Keves Castle. * When Ghondor escapes from Li Garte Prison Camp. In , this song plays when A kills Q and R.

Converging Emotions is a track from , composed by Manami Kiyota. It is track eight of disc seven from the Xenoblade 3 Original Soundtrack, and track eight of disc eighteen from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack Trinity Box. This song plays during the following moments: * During the party's struggle against the Moebius in Alfeto Valley in Chapter 1. * When the party thanks Ethel for her courage at the end of No Want of Courage. * Valdi finding his resolve at the end of The Kind Right Hand. * When Juniper requests to join the party at the end of Natural Selection. * When Joran sacrifices himself to take out D. * When Noah convinces Crys to move towards the future during Side Story: Noah. * Whe
Conduction Rise is one of Neilnail's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it by completing The Qlurian Archaeologist.
Colony 9 Wild Ride is a Nopon Grand Prix Battle Race Course in . It takes place in Colony 9 at night. This course starts at the top of Tephra Hill and finishes at Outlook Park.

Consumable Items are items in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be received as Division Rewards for Division activities. They can be used during battles, consumed for repairing or healing, or sold for Credits via the Inventory.
Combat Brax Ls are Heavy Wear left arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group and are a part of the combat armor range.
Combat Brax Rs are Heavy Wear right arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group and are a part of the combat armor range.

Combat Grip Rs are Medium Wear right arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Candid & Credible and are a part of the combat armor range.
Combat Armwear Ls are Heavy Wear left arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are a part of the Combat armor range.

Combat Wrest Rs are Heavy Wear right arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Candid & Credible and are a part of the Combat armor range.

Coppice Quadwings are enemies in . They are members of the Quadwing family, and can be found at level 23 in the Lacus Swamp, near Zaldania Waterfall, and near the Crown Tree in Satorl Marsh during the day. Defeating three of them is required to complete the Satorl Marsh's quest Monster Quest 2. They can drop the Quadwing Bags needed for Colony 6 Reconstruction.
Crest Gloves are light arm armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are part of Melia's initial equipment and can also be acquired through trading in Frontier Village.

Crimson Citruses (Japanese: , Kurenaisudachi) are collectables in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in Frontier Village. According to their description, they look hot because of their red pulps, but they are really just bitter. Two are required for World's Strongest Flavour.

Dabidabi (Japanese: ) is a Nopon in Xenoblade Chronicles. Initially he can be found on a balcony west of the Mysterious Sanctuary in Frontier Village. After completing Getting Bigger! and Who is Bigger? he will be found beside Adidi near the Reservoir from 18:00 to 06:00, and his trade list will change depending on which route was chosen.

Cute Brogs (Japanese: , Kyūto Guroggu) are enemies in . They are members of the Brog family, and can be found during the night at level 5-6 around Anti-Air Battery 1 and Cliff Lake in Colony 9, along the shoreline. They drop Medicinal Brog Oil, two lots of which are needed for the quest The Key to a Long Life. One of them must be defeated to complete Monster Quest 1 - Part 2.
Craft Bunnits (Japanese: , Kurafuto Banitto) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Bunnit family, and can be found at level 11 in Gaur Plain on the Bionis' Leg.

Cute Parsnips (Japanese: , Kyūto Sutoriberi, Cute Strawberry) are collectables in . They can be found in Satorl Marsh or by trading with Zazadan and Don Argentis once he moves to Colony 6. According to their description, they are pleasing to the eye and very sweet and some people use them for decoration.

Cool Lemons (Japanese: , Kurukūru Remon) are collectables in and . They can be found in Alcamoth. According to their description, they are cold lemons that calms the spirit and they are often eaten after arguments.

Cute Orchids (Japanese: , Kyuttoran) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 6. According to their description, their blooms are truly lovely but they are easily scattered away in the breeze.

Cool Potatoes (Japanese: , Kuruimo) are collectables in . They can be found in Colony 9. According to their description, they are cooling green roots that are particularly valued in the summer. Two are required for Collection Quest 1 in Frontier Village.

Crimson Gears (Japanese: , Kurimuzon Gia) are collectables in . They can be found in Sword Valley and Colony 6. According to their description, they are gearwheels coloured a lovely red, however no one has any idea for what they are.
The Crusher (Japanese: , Assai Kurasshu, Crushing Crash) is a weapon in . It is a gunlance wielded by Reyn.

The Crest Cap (Japanese: , Kuresuto Kyappu) is a light head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is Melia's initial head amour when she joins the party, and cannot be removed or sold during the time that she wears it, or kept in inventory after a certain point in the story.

The Cylinder Hangar (Japanese: , Shirindā Kakunōko) is a landmark in . It is located in Colony 9, but can only be reached by going through Tephra Cave. Shulk, Reyn and Fiora enter Tephra Cave for the first time in order to reach this location.
Crest Shoes are light feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are part of Melia's initial armour, and are not obtainable in any other way.
Cool Gel (Japanese: , Kūru Jeru) is light head armour in . It is part of the swimsuit-style Cool Set along with Cool Oil, Cool Cream, Cool Trunks, and Cool Sandals.
Crest Bottoms are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Melia's initial leg armour. They are only otherwise obtainable by trading.
Cool Trunks are light legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They come equipped with a Blaze Defence III gem.
Crest Tops are light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are Melia's initial torso armour. They are otherwise only available by trading.
Cool Oil is light torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be dropped by various enemies, traded for, or bought at two Shops in Colony 6.
Court Leggings are medium legs armour in . They can be dropped by various enemies.

Crevasse Waterfall (Japanese: , Sakeme no Taki) is a location in . It is located on the lower level and northeast of Bionis' Leg. It is a waterfall that flows off the edge of one of the holes on the upper level, past the lower level, presumably falling forever. There is no land beneath it. It is reached by going through Windy Cave. The path goes right in front of it.
Covert Snipers (Japanese: , Haidosunaipu, Hide Sniper) are weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are rifles that can be wielded by Sharla. They can only be acquired by purchasing them at a few shops.
Critical Up (Japanese: , Kaishin Appu) is a Gem in that increases the chance of a Critical Hit. __TOC__
The Crown Pike (Japanese: , Kuraunpaiku) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is a gunlance wielded by Reyn. It can only be obtained through purchase.
Cumulo Cutlasses (Japanese: , Sekiran'untō) are weapons in . They are swords wielded by Dunban, and are not dropped by any enemies. Instead they can be traded for, or given as a quest reward.

Cosmic Nibbler (Japanese: , Inseki no Bakubaku, Meteorite Nibbler) is a weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is one of Riki's biters. It is only obtainable by completing the Collectopaedia for Sword Valley.
Corporal Gauntlets are medium arms armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are exclusive to Dunban. They are worn by him when he first joins the party, and cannot be removed or sold.
Corporal Boots are medium feet armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are worn by Dunban when he first joins the party, and cannot be removed or sold.

Corporal Cap (Japanese: , Homusu no Heichōbō) is medium head armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is exclusive to Dunban, being worn by him when he first joins the party, and cannot be removed or sold. Although classified as medium armour, it has the same icon as most of the light head armours, including Colony Cap and Nine Cap.
Corporal Belts are medium legs armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are worn by Dunban when he first joins the party, and cannot be removed or sold.

The Crown Tree (Japanese: , Ōkanju) is a landmark in . It is a large tree located in Satorl Marsh, far west of the Barren Moor and southwest of the Poison Swamp. There is a Heart-to-Heart on one of the branches - "Atop the Crown Tree", between Sharla and Riki. Like all the trees in the marsh, Ether can be seen glowing in the upper branches at night.

Cursed Berryjammy (Japanese: , Norowareta Sutorojamu) is a quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It can be received from Norara at a balcony of a building from the Reconstruction HQ, only after Mefimefi and Berryjammy have been invited to Colony 6. If Shulk is in the active party, he will comment. Obstinate Berryjammy will be triggered upon completing this quest. This quest and Weak Berryjammy are mutually exclusive.

Cure Bullet (Japanese: , Kyua Baretto) is one of Sharla's Ether arts in . It removes debuffs from and grants temporary Debuff Immunity to one party member. In , Kino has an identical version of this art called Cure Thingamie.
Corporal Attire is medium torso armour in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is exclusive to Dunban, worn by him when he first joins the party, and cannot be removed or sold.

Covert Stance (Japanese: , Haido Sutansu, Hide Stance) is one of Sharla's arts in . It activates an aura that reduces her total aggro by a certain percentage and prevents aggro gain from attacks or healing while it is active. The colour of the aura is black. In , Kino has an identical version of this art called Yoghurt Stance.
Cross Impact (Japanese: , Kurosu Inpakuto) is one of Fiora's physical arts in . Fiora kicks the enemy twice, inflicting damage. It also inflicts Daze if used against a Toppled enemy.

Cure Round (Japanese: , Kyua Raundo) is one of Sharla's support arts in . It removes all debuffs from and grants Debuff Immunity to all battle party members. In , Kino has an identical version of this art called Curedy-Pure Round.

Crazed is an Aura used by some enemies in . The colour of the aura is a mixture of red and purple. The enemy usually activates the Crazed Aura when its HP is at least less than 50%. The duration of the aura depends on the enemy.

Cute Caterpiles (Japanese: , Kyūto Kyapiru) are caterpillar-like enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Caterpile family, and can be found in the Caterpile Nest in Tephra Cave. They drop Caterpile Poison, five lots of which is needed if following Leopold's branch in the quest Financial Planning.
Corriente Krabbles (Japanese: , Koriente Kuraibu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Krabble family, and can be found at level 53 on Digit 5 Beach on the Fallen Arm.

Crisis Response Units (Japanese: , Kinkyū Bōei-gata Kyōshūshiki) are quest exclusive Mechon in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be found in the Central Factory in the Mechon Factory. They appear during Daring Assault. Two of them must be defeated along with the M96 Crisis Unit to complete Daring Assault. They drop Reinforced Jets, which are required for Best Boots. All three respawn after completing the quest. The M96 Crisis Unit may summon two others Crisis Response Units during the fight.

Croaking Brog Bags are rare materials in . They can be obtained from Singing Brogs in Tephra Cave, or traded for with Nic whilst he is still in Colony 9. According to their description, they are bags full of Brog laughter that makes croaking sounds. Two are needed for The Plan - Preparation.

Crystal Antol Eyes are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Red and Yellow Antols in Colony 6. Crystal Antol Eyes are also available via trade with Perrine, Yura, and Norara after they have migrated to Colony 6. According to their description, they are highly transparent compound eyes that can be made into a top-quality lens.

Corona Elements are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from Bagrus Nebulae in Makna Forest. Corona Elements are not otherwise available. According to their description, they are flame elements that emit a beautiful cylindrical light, but are also very hot.
Cracked Parts S are common materials in . They can be dropped by M42 Scout Unit and Mechon M55 in the Ether Mine. They can also be obtained via trade.
Cracked Parts M are common materials in . They can be obtained from Mechon M67 in the Ether Mine. They are not available otherwise.
Cracked Parts L are common materials in . They can be obtained from Mechon M84 units in the Ether Mine. They can also be obtained through trade.

Cross (, Kurosu) is the default name used on this wiki to designate the Avatar, the customizable playable character of . They are created by the player and exists through the choices made during the game. They are sometimes referred to by other characters as "Rook".

Curators is a division within BLADE. This Division pioneers and surveys Mira's various locations and collects materials for research. This division is also known as Colepedian (Japanese: , Korepedian) in the Japanese version, a reference to the Collectopaedia from , which was called "Colepedia" in Japanese. Curators receive increased Division Points from gathering collectables and defeating Tyrants. Receiving division support from Curators grants Critical Master, which increases chance of inflicting Critical Hits.

Crisis (危機) is an Event Track in , composed and arranged by ACE+. It is track 8 of disc 1 from the Xenoblade Original Soundtrack. This music is a heightened, urgent theme that is heard in the following cutscenes: * The party see Mechon invading Colony 9 after retrieving Ether Cylinders * After not finding Dunban at home, the party heads to the Weapon Development Lab instead * Metal Face and his Mechon defeat Colonel Vangarre and the Defence Force in the Military District * Fiora splits off from the party after the Mechon ambush them at the Central Plaza * Xord captures Juju at Spiral Valley * Otharon dumps Xord into the ether river at the Central Pit - Base Level * Melia and her bodyguards f

Coral Forfexes (Japanese: , Kōraru Pagurusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Forfex family, and can be found at level 21-25 on the coasts of Primordia, such as at Northpointe Cove.
Crisis Zone is one of Phog's two Signature Arts in . Cross can learn it by completing Blitzkrieg.

Cursed Adseculas (Japanese: , Kāsu Apisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Adsecula family, and can be found at level 55-56 in the Molten Hollow of Primordia. Some of them hide on the walls.

Copper Ciniculas (Japanese: , Kappā Vasaruto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cinicula family, and can be found at level 21-30 at South Janpath Plain, Talon Rock Second Terrane or Grieving Plains in Primordia.

no4=D91M is a track in , composed and arranged by Hiroyuki Sawano. It is track four of disc one from the XenobladeX Original Soundtrack, and the fourth part of the suite titled 0rCH-SUITE "X". This track plays during the folowing cutscenes: * When the party finds Kun'luarb during Circle of Life. * Lao explaining his motivations for working with the Ganglion between the phases of the Prog Ares battle in Chapter 11. * Plays during Lend an Ear * Yelv discovering that his partner is dead at the end of Yelv's Partner * Sacrificing Auld Belgazus to the Auravis in A New Life. * When Erio informs the party of the location of her sisters' base during Definian Downfall.

Crusher Mortifoles (Japanese: , Masshu Foriumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Mortifoles and can be found at level 31-37 on the pathway between Yagami's Vista and the Sapphire Carpet in Noctilum.
Critical Combination is a Soul Voice in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is triggered when a party member lands three consecutive critical hits.
Copper Potamuses (Japanese: , Kappā Hippo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Potamus family, and can be found at level 24-27 in Oblivia, southeast of FN Site 309.
Crusher Terebras (Japanese: , Masshu Rutoru, Mash Lutru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Terebra family. They can be found at level 36-39 in Noctilum's Whale's Weeper.

The Crater Oasis (Japanese: , Kurētā Oashisu) is an Unexplored Territory in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Oblivia, at the western end of Barbarich Desert. It is a small pit containing a tiny pool of water. The oasis itself has no enemies, some Collectibles, and one field treasure. As with all Unexplored Territories, its discovery yields an achievement ("The Bottom of Crater Oasis").

Crane Turbas (Japanese: , Kurein Kurekusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Turba family, and can be found at level 44-45 just off the edge of the Cinderdunes in Sylvalum.

Coronids (Japanese: , Regurī) are huge quadrupedal creatures in Xenoblade Chronicles X. There are only four known types, two minor enemies and two Tyrants, and they are all found in Sylvalum, commonly at Lake Ciel. They are similar to Millesaurs.
Cranjellies (Japanese: , Kuranjerī) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia. Four are required for the Basic Mission Behold the Cranjelly.

Creek Unafulges (Japanese: , Kurīku Purumō) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Unafulge family, and can be found at level 16-18 at FN Site 403 and at the center of Seabird's Beak in Sylvalum. Three must be defeated to complete Bottoms Up. They may pop out of the ground when approached.

Creeping Blattas (Japanese: , Kurīpu Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family. They can be found at level 3-10 at West Gate Plain in Primordia during daytime. Four must be defeated with the Titanium Knife II to complete the Basic Mission Arms Testers Wanted.
Corwin (Japanese: , Korondasu) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is located at Division Drive in the Administrative District. He is a member of the Pathfinders Division.

Credits are the currency in the world of . The party can obtain credits from completing missions, selling items in Armory Alley, or from Treasure Boxes found on Mira. The sell price listed in item infoboxes is the amount received when selling that item. For weapons and armor, the purchase price, the amount of credits needed to buy the equipment from Armory Alley, is 100 times the sell price.

Crush Rings (Japanese: , Kurasshuringu) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular on Arendt Bridge north of FN Site 111 or near Castaway Cavern at any time, although their spawn rate is higher at night and early morning. Five are required for the Basic Mission A Clandestine Operation.

Cowardly Caecuses (Japanese: , Chikin Doren, Chicken Caecus) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Caecus family, and can be found at level 8-9 at the Emerian Battlegrounds outside the entrance to the White Phosphor Lake in Cauldros.

Cross Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kurosu Kumūba) are five Mission Exclusive Secondary Bosses in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 22-25 east of Everwhelm Falls in Noctilum. Defeating them is required during Frontier Spirit.

Cruise Deflector AiR (Japanese: , Kōkō Defurekutā AiR) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia. Four of them are required for the Affinity Mission The Repair Job. The first appearance of these items can be found upon arriving in Oblivia at the two entrances. All of the required Cruise Deflector AiRs for this mission can be found at these entrances.

Cunning Thalluses (Japanese: , Kaningu Arudare) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Thallus family. They can be found at level 41-42 in Noctilum, hanging from the ceiling of the Rockmole's Burrow entrance tunnel.
Crawling Bats (Japanese: , Bōbaddo) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia.
Cosse Beans (Japanese: , Kosse-mame) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia, in particular around Lake Basel. Five are needed for Bread and a Circus.
Crystal Butterflies (Japanese: , Kurisutaru Batafurai) are prime collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found at Seabird's Beak.

Cordless Transformers (Japanese: , Kōdoresu E Toransu) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum at Lake Ciel. Five of them are needed during Reclaiming the Whale (Cordless Transformers).
Copper Papils (Japanese: , Kappā Papirio) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Papil family, and can be found at level 22 in Suncatch Ravine in Noctilum at daytime.

Crystal Blattas (Japanese: , Kurisutaru Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family. They can be found at level 54-55 in Banshee Cave and at level 58 in Quay Hollows in Sylvalum.
Cooling Lavas (Japanese: , Kuringu Yōgan) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.
Crazed Femina Suids (Japanese: , Maddo Femina Zūsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Suid family, and can be found at level 11-19 north of Oblivia's Twin Arches.

Crater Saltats (Japanese: , Kuretia Sarutāto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 48-49 near FN Site 509 at Capital Wreckage in Cauldros during clear weather, rarely replacing the Gypsy Saltats there.

Crested Saltats (Japanese: , Kuresuto Sarutāto) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Saltat family, and can be found at level 42-43 inside the large cage-like structure northeast of Mount M'gando in Cauldros during clear weather.

Crawler Blattas (Japanese: , Adoraputo Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 31-40 in Primordia, near FN Site 109 or FN Site 110 during the day.

Crazed Aeviters (Japanese: , Maddo Tidāra) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Aeviter family, and can be found at level 63-64 at Sentinel's Nest in Noctilum. They are hidden in the pools, resembling statues.

Crude Neilnail Masks are intergalactic materials in . They are needed for the creation of all level 60 Skells except for the Excavator. Twelve are needed to craft an Ares 90 Skell, and six are needed to craft an Ares 70. They can be obtained from the BLADE terminal for 210 Reward Tickets (475 Material Tickets in the ) each or from the time attack mission Twin Dolls of Mystery. They can also be obtained by clearing squad missions which involve defeating Neilnail Skells.

Coral Purgovents (Japanese: , Kōraru Morumu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Purgovent family, and can be found at level 37-40 at Azure Lagoon and North Coast in Oblivia.
Coral Xiphias (Japanese: , Kōraru Rumederu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Xiphias family, and can be found at level 31-40 in Primordia, northeast of FN Site 120.

Coral Balaenas (Japanese: , Kōraru Baraena) are minor enemies in . They are members of the Balaena family, and can be found at level 38-40 in Primordia. There are two at level 38-40 located in the northern Primordia Waters just south of Sylvalum's FN Site 403. One can be found at level 32-39 located south of La Mancha; it is sometimes replaced with Rajidi, the Cumuliform.

Dadaan Squad Members (Japanese: , Dadān-dan Dan'in) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 58-60 at the Scabland Fortress in Oblivia. They are troopers in the squad that assists Dadaan, the Strongest Prone.
Crisis Catalyst is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Full Metal Jaguar at rank 7.

Core Crusher is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Psycorruptor at rank 10. Damage from ether-attribute weapons and Arts cannot damage appendages, but in exchange, they deal more damage overall. Core Crusher will not take effect if an enemy does not have appendages or if all have been broken. Core Crusher is treated as an independent multiplier that affects overall damage instead of an additive multiplier like Ether Boost.

DV482: Duvel (Japanese: , DV 482: Dyūvu) is a Definian NPC and Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She appears at Cauldros's Kw'arah Cloister during Alex's Last Stand, and must be defeated to complete the mission.
Dadapon's Sunglasses are an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are obtained in the Headwater Cavern in Primordia during The Ties That Bind. The place is guarded by the Bizarre Insidia.
Da Girhi is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a Wrothian who can be at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia at daytime.
Da Naguth is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian who can be at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia at nighttime.
Da Zeulbe is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Wrothian who can be at the Wrothian Stronghold in Oblivia at nighttime.
Culling Caecuses is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Pathfinders and the primary destination is Sylvalum.

The Cunning Sylooth (Japanese: , Kaningu Shirūsu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Sylooth family, and is fought at level 36 along with the Daunting Sylooth at Delusians South Summit in Sylvalum during Turf War.
Coolest of the Cool is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Dodonga Caravan and the primary destination is Noctilum.
Covert Operations is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Pathfinders and the primary destination is Sylvalum.
The Crimson Tear is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is one of the objectives of The Ultimate Price.
Culture Shocks is a Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located at the Sports Complex in the Residential District of New Los Angeles between Hope and Cross at anytime.
Crimson Dilus Eyes are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from blue Diluses, or for 90 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Crimson Sacrifole Feathers are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from red Sacrifoles, or for 54 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components for Melee: TP Gain Up and Custom.WP-M-GP augments.
Coronid Dung is a prime material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Coronids.

Coronid Larynges are prime materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Coronids, or for 168 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV and XX Firing Range Up and Custom.WP-R-RANGE augments.
Coronid A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black and blue coronid variant. It can be obtained from Xair, the Cerulean Walker at Sylvalum Waters.
Coronid B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a black and red coronid variant. It can be obtained from Ignit, the Ultimate Chaos in Sylvalum.

Crab Feast is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.7, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting four Ferdinand, the Fortuitous. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Creature Removal is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.7, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting eight Turbas. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Custom Tank Tops are casual torso armors made by Sakuraba Industries in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are available through several missions. All colors in this set have the same stats.

Corporate Espionage is a Squad Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of BLADE Mission No.18, and is unlocked if a Qmoeva's head was broken during Taunting the Prone. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Cooldown Reducer is a ground weapon mod Augment in and that reduces the cooldown time between auto-attacks. The Skell equivalent is Custom.WP-SPEED.
Critical Chance Up is a ground weapon critical Augment in and that increases the chance of scoring a critical hit. The Skell equivalent is CriticalUp.
The DARKGOD is a Skell Weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Its models are only obtained as a reward for completing the Time Attack Mission Dark Matter Phantom. It resembles the sword used by the Vita.

Custom.WP-R-RANGE is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It boosts the range of the Skell ranged weapon it is equipped on by 2 to 40 meters. It is the Skell equivalent of Firing Range Up.
Critical Surge is a ground weapon Soul Voice augment in and . It increases the chance of triggering the Heavy Hitter Soul Voice by 10% to 50%.
Crush Surge is a ground weapon Soul Voice augment in and . It increases the chance of triggering the Dismemberer Soul Voice by 5% to 25%.
is a Skell frame debuff resistance augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces the duration of debuffs on a Skell by 5% to 25%. It is the Skell equivalent of Debuff Suppressor.

Crimson Aurora Screen is a ground armor anticlimate augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It cannot be crafted at the AM Terminal and is only available as a built-in augment on Meredith & Co. and Orphean Technologies torso armor.

Custom.WP-MSL-MAG‎ is a Skell weapon mod Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases the number of shots that missile-based weapons fire at the cost of reducing their damage. It cannot be crafted at the AM Terminal, and can only be found as a built-in augment on missile-based Skell weapons. It can be upgraded.
Crush.APPEND is a Skell weapon special Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases damage dealt to enemy appendages by 5% to 100%. It is the Skell equivalent of Ranged Appendage Damage.

CriticalUp.ULTRAFAUNA is a Skell weapon critical augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases critical chance when attacking Ultrafauna-classified enemies. It is the Skell equivalent of Ultrafauna Criticals Up.
Custom.WP-FUEL is a Skell weapon custom augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces the fuel consumption of the Skell weapon it is equipped on by 1% to 20%.
Custom Diving Bodywear are Casual Wear torso armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.

CriticalUp.THEROID is a Skell weapon critical augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases critical chance when attacking Theroid-classified enemies. It is the Skell equivalent of Theroid Criticals Up.

CriticalUp.INSECTOID is a Skell weapon critical augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases critical chance when attacking Insectoid-classified enemies. It is the Skell equivalent of Insectoid Criticals Up.

CriticalUp.PISCINOID is a Skell weapon critical augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases critical chance when attacking Piscinoid-classified enemies. It is the Skell equivalent of Piscinoid Criticals Up.

CriticalUp.HUMANOID is a Skell weapon critical augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases critical chance when attacking Humanoid-classified enemies. It is the Skell equivalent of Humanoid Criticals Up.

CriticalUp.CHIMEROID is a Skell weapon critical augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases critical chance when attacking Chimeroid-classified enemies. It is the Skell equivalent of Chimeroid Criticals Up.

CriticalUp.MECHANOID is a Skell weapon critical augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases critical chance when attacking Mechanoid-classified enemies. It is the Skell equivalent of Mechanoid Criticals Up.
Custom.WP-SPEED is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It reduces the cooldown of the Skell weapon the augment is attached to. The ground equivalent is Cooldown Reducer.
Custom.WP-M-GP is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases GP gain on melee auto-attacks in a Skell. It is the Skell equivalent of Melee: TP Gain Up.
Custom.WP-R-GP is a Skell weapon augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It increases GP gain on ranged auto-attacks in a Skell. It is the Skell equivalent of Ranged: TP Gain Up.

Cracked Bills are common materials in . They can be obtained from Gust Vangs, Black Flamii, and Oasis Flamii on Bionis' Leg. Cracked Bills are not otherwise obtainable. According to their description, someone could attach a stick to them to make shovels, though they would not be usable.
Cracked Claws are common materials in . They can be obtained from Coppice Quadwing and Satorl Vangs in Satorl Marsh. Cracked Claws are also available via trading.

Creare Glyphs are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from level 80-89 Unique Monsters. Creare Glyphs are not otherwise obtainable. According to their description, the truth of creation is inscribed on them and like every glyph, they sell for a high price on the market.

Crawler Caterpiles (Japanese: , Kurourā Kyapiru) are enemies in . They are members of the Caterpile family and can be found at level 5-7 on the Lower Level of the Gormott Province, slightly northwest of the Old Ghostwood Road Skip Travel point. Some of them can be summoned by Wormeater Brog by using its art "Sumo Press", and by Gorian Buloofo by using its art "Beast Howl". Four of them must be defeated to unlock Agate's level 2 Rhodochrosite Might.

Crimson Flamiis (Japanese: , Beniiro Furamī) are enemies in . They are members of the Flamii family and can be found at level 9-13 on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province, particularly at Lyta Oasis or Coolley Lake.

Corpse Sacrifoles are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are level 37 Sacrifoles, and can be found in Cauldros, on a ledge below and southeast of Bestial Utopia. They are accompanied by a level 37 Hardy Aprica. They appear during A Present for Hope after the party speaks to Lularita, and disappear after the Reverend's Journal is obtained. It is not necessary to fight them, and they do not drop any items. If killed, they will respawn one minute later.
Custom Glasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group and are a part of the custom armor range.
Custom Round Glasses are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Grenada Galactic Group and are a part of the custom armor range.
Custom Swimmer's Band Ls are Casual Wear left arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are a part of the custom armor range.
Custom Swimmer's Band Rs are Casual Wear right arm armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are a part of the custom armor range.
Custom Swimsuit Tops are Casual Wear torso armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are a part of the custom armor range.
Crustips (Japanese: , Shuribu) are a family of aquatic enemies in the , first appearing in . They resemble large lobster-like creatures, and come in red and blue varieties.
Coral Reversi are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Hobby Knick-Knacks in Fonsa Myma in the Kingdom of Uraya. They are one of the Rex's favorite Pouch items.
Cream Orange Parathas are Staple Food Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Tilly Bakery in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. They are one of Nia's favorite Pouch items.
Cyclone Smash (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Rex's arts when using the Dual Scythes.

Crystal Clear (Japanese: , Koakurisutaru-gari, Core Crystal Hunters) is a Blade Quest in . It can be started on Obra Street in Torigoth, after starting Chapter 5, having ten Core Crystals in inventory and buying a rumor about Core Crystal Hunters from the Informant shop of the Empire of Mor Ardain or the Informant shop in Garfont Village.
Crown Splitter (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Mòrag's arts when using a Megalance. It inflicts Smash.

Coolley Lake (Japanese: , Kūreru-ko) is a location in . It is located on the right upper level of the Gormott Province. It is by far the largest body of water on the Titan and parallels the entire length of Torigoth. Clear Sky Beak is directly above the lake, and the Plains of Evening Calm are directly west of the lake, and the Torigoth Flower Patch is to the east.

The Crown of Sanctuary (Japanese: , Seiiki no Ōkan) is a Landmark in . It is located in the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, above the Coralline Sanctum. It can be directly reached by running south from Tardy Gate, and following the path past Badfella's Cave Fort. There are no enemies here, although there is a Phonex village.

The Coralline Sanctum (Japanese: , Sango no Seiiki) is a location in . It is located in the south-eastern corner of the Stomach of the Kingdom of Uraya, below the Crown of Sanctuary; it consists of a large pool with raised pads that can be climbed. The Sealstone of Water, required for Zenobia's Blade Quest, is located in the raised pool here.
Cosmetipolitan is a shop in . It is run by Jill and can be found at Grodd Residential Zone in the Gormott Province. It is specialized in Cosmetics.
Curled Eyelashes are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cleo's Cosmetics in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Praxis.
Coral Nopon Chess Sets are Board Game Pouch items in . They can be purchased at the Nopox Hobby Store in the Argentum Trade Guild.
Crispy Sautés are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Llysiau Greens in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
The Cosmetipolitan Deeds are Store Deed key items in . They can be purchased from Cosmetipolitan in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Coralline Marimbas are Instrument Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Soniarus Music run by Tros in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
